The rise of Artificial Intelligence is transforming the digital landscape, but it is also creating a new generation of cyber threats. AI can automate phishing, deepfakes, social engineering, malware development and large-scale cyberattacks with unprecedented speed and sophistication.

The real challenge is no longer simply man versus machine—it is securing human trust in an AI-driven digital world. India’s growing digital ecosystem makes cybersecurity, data protection, responsible AI governance and cyber awareness essential pillars of national security.

We must ensure that AI becomes a shield against cyber threats, not a weapon in the hands of cybercriminals. The future of digital security will depend on innovation, regulation, ethical responsibility and continuous preparedness.

“In the age of AI, cybersecurity is not merely a technological requirement—it is a matter of digital sovereignty and public trust.”
